location: Guaranteed drop: Weeping Peninsula Dropped by a Scarab found north of the small, poisonous body of water east of the final stretch of road to Castle Morne. More specifically, it's south of the Castle Morne Rampart Site of Grace and northeast of the Castle Morne Lift Site of Grace, and east of...
whatItIs: A cloud of poison that drifts forward from the caster and lingers in the air. It costs 18 FP for one slot and asks for 12 Faith. The mist can be cast while moving, so it can be fired on the run or during a dodge.
whyItMatters: The lingering cloud damages anything that passes through it, which is handy against fast enemies that keep re-entering the area. A Faith build that wants a cheap zone-control tool gets one here without spending much FP.
whenToUse: Fire it into a narrow corridor or into the space where a boss teleports back in, then wait for the mist to do its work. It drops early in the Weeping Peninsula, released by a Scarab found north of the small, poisonous body of water east of the final stretch of road to Castle Morne, south of the Castle Morne Rampart Site of Grace and northeast of the Castle Morne Lift Site of Grace.
name: Poison Mist
effect: Releases poison mist before caster

desc: A superior incantation of Erdtree Worship. Increase damage negation for all affinities except physical for both the caster and nearby allies. Hold to continue praying and delay activation. In the beginning, everything was in opposition to the Erdtree. But through countless victories in war, it became the embodiment of Order.
location: Guaranteed Drop: Altus Plateau Protection of the Erdtree is obtained upon defeating a Teardrop Scarab located on a square platform upon a hill southeast of the Road of Iniquity Side Path Site of Grace.
whatItIs: A faith-based shield that raises damage negation against all elemental affinities except physical for the caster and nearby allies. It costs 30 FP for one slot and requires 35 Faith. Holding the cast button delays activation, letting the user time the buff just before a hit lands.
whyItMatters: Because it covers fire, lightning, and holy damage simultaneously, it turns a one-shot elemental boss into a survivable encounter. A Faith build that struggles against fire or lightning attacks gains a reliable answer without juggling multiple buffs.
whenToUse: Channel it right before a boss telegraphs a big elemental attack, or keep it active during the entire fight against a magic-heavy enemy. It is obtained in the Altus Plateau by defeating a Teardrop Scarab on a square platform on a hill southeast of the Road of Iniquity Side Path Site of Grace.
name: Protection of the Erdtree
effect: Increases affinity damage negation for self & allies

desc: One of the incantations of the Golden Order fundamentalists. A gift of gratitude to the young Miquella from his father, Radagon. Produces a golden ring of light and fires it across a wide area. Charging enhances range. And yet, the young Miquella abandoned fundamentalism, for it could do nothing to treat Malenia's accursed rot. This was the beginning of unalloyed gold.
location: Purchase: Roundtable Hold / Liurnia of the Lakes / Altus Plateau / Leyndell, Royal Capital / Mountaintops of the Giants Sold for 7,500 Runes by Brother Corhyn or Miriel, Pastor of Vows after giving either of them the Golden Order Principia. Should the prayerbook be given to one of them and then...
whatItIs: Golden Order incantation that conjures a ring of light and hurls it across a wide area in front of the caster. It costs 29 FP for one slot and demands both 31 Intelligence and 31 Faith, marking it as a hybrid spell. Charging extends the range of the ring.
whyItMatters: The wide arc hits groups cleanly and the golden damage type bypasses many physical resistances. A faith-intelligence hybrid build gets a solid mid-range attack that does not require close contact, while a pure Faith build can still access it at the stat floor.
whenToUse: Cast it at mid range against clusters of enemies or at a boss that keeps its distance, and hold the button to stretch the ring further when spacing is an issue. Purchase it for 7,500 Runes from Brother Corhyn or Miriel, Pastor of Vows, after handing either of them the Golden Order Principia.
name: Radagon's Rings of Light
effect: Creates golden ring of light to attack wide area

desc: Incantation of Salza, sage of the Fire Knights. Summons a cloud of flame overhead that pelts foe with rain of fire from above. Charging increases potency. Salza's disdain for barbarism never waned, even as he burned more villages and scorched more land than any other.
location: Drop: Shadow Keep Dropped by a Fire Knight in Shadow Keep that uses this spell, together with Salza's Hood. He's found at the end of the bridge just west of the West Rampart Site of Grace in the westernmost part of the Keep, and will try to target the player for large sections of the bridge...
whatItIs: Messmerfire incantation that summons a cloud of flame overhead and rains fire down on the target area. It costs 27 FP for one slot and demands 52 Faith, a substantial requirement for a single-slot spell. Charging increases the potency of the downpour.
whyItMatters: The area-of-effect damage from above catches enemies that would otherwise roll past a ground-level spell, and the fire damage type hits hard against frost and poison-resistant foes. A Faith build with 52 points to spare gains a reliable mid-range burst that covers a wide patch of ground.
whenToUse: Cast it when enemies are packed under open sky or when a boss teleports in and lands in a fixed spot, then let the rain finish the job. Rain of Fire requires the Shadow of the Erdtree expansion and is dropped by a Fire Knight at the end of the bridge just west of the West Rampart Site of Grace in the westernmost part of Shadow Keep.
name: Rain of Fire
effect: Momentarily sparks roaring flame from hand

desc: Sorcery of the servants of Death. Summons vengeful spirits that chase down foes. Charging enhances potency. Once though lost, this ancient death hex was rediscovered by the necromancer Garris.
location: Guaranteed Drop: Stormveil Castle Acquired from felling the Scarab on the road down to the Visage of Godwyn, southwest of the Liftside Chamber Site of Grace.
whatItIs: Death school sorcery that summons vengeful spirits which chase down nearby foes. It costs 12 FP for one slot and asks for 16 Intelligence plus 14 Faith. Charging boosts the potency of the spirits before they are released.
whyItMatters: The spirits pursue their targets, so the spell does not require a clear line of sight and can catch enemies hiding behind cover. A low-investment early caster or a faith-intelligence hybrid gets a simple, reliable damage option that works at any range.
whenToUse: Fire it when a boss or enemy group is spread out, because the spirits split up and track individually. It is a guaranteed drop in Stormveil Castle, taken from the Scarab on the road down to the Visage of Godwyn, southwest of the Liftside Chamber Site of Grace.
name: Rancorcall
effect: Summons vengeful spirits that chase down foes

desc: Legendary sorcery associated with the Carian queen. Uses the caster as a vessel to incarnate a cold, dark moon, then sends it floating toward foes. The dark moon dispels all sorcery that touches it, and temporarily reduces magic damage negation for those it strikes. The moon was encountered by a young Ranni, led by the hand of her mother, Rennala. What she beheld was cold, dark and veiled in occult mystery.
location: Chelona's Rise, in the south-west of the Moonfolk Ruins. You'll have to solve the puzzle with the three spirit turtles. One is right next to the Rise, the other at the cliff south-east of the Lunar Estate Ruins on a ledge and the third is flying above the evergaol portal in the north-west....
whatItIs: Carian sorcery that incarnates a cold, dark moon and sends it drifting toward the target. It costs 57 FP for two slots and demands 68 Intelligence. The moon dispels any sorcery it touches and temporarily lowers the magic damage negation of whatever it strikes.
whyItMatters: The dispel effect strips enemy magical defenses, making it a strong setup for follow-up hits, and the moon's slow drift gives it a long travel time to track a target. A high-Intelligence build that wants to break through a boss's magic resistances has a dedicated tool here.
whenToUse: Cast it just before unleashing a burst of damage on a boss with high magic resistance, so the dispel window overlaps the big hit. It sits at Chelona's Rise in the south-west of the Moonfolk Ruins, guarded by a puzzle involving three spirit turtles: one beside the Rise, one on a ledge at the cliff south-east of the Lunar Estate Ruins, and one flying above the evergaol portal in the north-west.
name: Ranni's Dark Moon
effect: Incarnate a cold, dark moon and launch it at foes.

desc: Incantation of the Two Fingers' faithful. Produces a shockwave that knocks back nearby foes. Charging increases the size of the shockwave. Hark, Tarnished! If you truly walk in faith, you must be prepared to reject all else.
location: Purchase: Roundtable Hold / Altus Plateau / Leyndell, Royal Capital / Mountaintops of the Giants Sold for 1,500 Runes by Brother Corhyn. Should Corhyn die before purchasing this Incantation from him, the player can still purchase it from the Twin Maiden Husks for the same price, after giving...
whatItIs: Two Fingers incantation that produces a shockwave pushing nearby foes away from the caster. It costs just 9 FP for one slot and needs only 12 Faith. Charging enlarges the radius of the knockback.
whyItMatters: The knockback creates instant space, which is the fastest way to break a boss combo or escape a corner. Any Faith build, even a low-level one, can slot this in and use it as a panic button without worrying about FP costs.
whenToUse: Trigger it the moment a boss locks into a multi-hit combo or when a crowd closes in and the character has nowhere to roll. Purchase it for 1,500 Runes from Brother Corhyn at the Roundtable Hold, the Altus Plateau, Leyndell, Royal Capital, or the Mountaintops of the Giants.
name: Rejection
effect: Produces a shockwave that pushes away foes

desc: Sorcery of Rellana, the Twin Moon Knight. Associated with a Carian princess. Incarnate overlapping twin moons which strike the ground one after the other, violently shaking the earth with moonlight. In her childhood, she and her elder sister Rennala met these moons. Overlapping, as though nestled against one another.
location: Trade: Roundtable Hold Trade the Remembrance of the Twin Moon Knight, gained by defeating Rellana, Twin Moon Knight, with Finger Reader Enia. Alternatively, use one of the Remembrance Duplication Coffins to duplicate one (can only obtain one per playthrough using either method).
whatItIs: Twin moons incarnated as overlapping discs that strike the ground one after another in a line. It costs 47 FP for two slots and demands 72 Intelligence. The successive impacts shake the earth with each landing point.
whyItMatters: The multi-hit pattern covers a long stretch of ground, making it effective against bosses that walk in a straight line or against groups spread along a path. A maxed-out Intelligence build gains a high-damage spell with good area coverage and no charging requirement.
whenToUse: Line up the first moon on a boss that is standing still between phases, then let the chained impacts drag it out of position. It belongs to the Shadow of the Erdtree add-on; unlock it by defeating Rellana, Twin Moon Knight, then turning the Remembrance of the Twin Moon Knight in to Finger Reader Enia at Roundtable Hold.
name: Rellana's Twin Moons
effect: Incarnate twin moons and repeatedly strike the ground

desc: Sorcery associated with the Carian queen. Uses the caster as a vessel to incarnate a full moon, then sends it floating toward foes. The full moon dispels all sorcery that touches it, and temporarily reduces magic damage negation for those it strikes. Queen Rennala encountered this enchanting moon when she was young, and later, it would bewitch the academy.
location: Trade the Remembrance of the Full Moon Queen, gained by defeating Rennala, Queen of the Full Moon, with Finger Reader Enia. Alternatively, use one of the Wandering Mausoleums with a bell to duplicate one (can only obtain one per playthrough using either method).
whatItIs: The Carian queen's moon rises from the caster and sails toward the enemy in a slow, sweeping arc. On contact it erases any sorcery in the space around it and briefly lowers the target's magic damage negation. It demands a very high Intelligence score and drinks a heavy share of the FP pool per cast.
whyItMatters: The dispel and resistance-break combo makes it a strong opener before a damage burst, and the slow travel time lets the caster reposition while the moon is in flight. A high-Intelligence build gets a reliable mid-to-long range attack that also weakens the target's magical defenses.
whenToUse: Cast it at the start of a boss encounter to strip magic resistances, then follow up with the biggest damage spell in the loadout. It is obtained by trading the Remembrance of the Full Moon Queen, gained by defeating Rennala, Queen of the Full Moon, to Finger Reader Enia, or by using one of the Wandering Mausoleums with a bell.
name: Rennala's Full Moon
effect: Incarnate a full moon and launch it at foes

desc: Sorcery practiced by the keepers of the spiritgraves, where all death ultimately drifts. Creates rings of spectral light that fire in unison. Charging enhances potency. The rings of light have the same qualities as ghostflame, and deal magic damage while also causing frost buildup.
location: Found in Charo's Hidden Grave on top of the arch leading from the Site of Grace to the Death Rite Bird. Go east from the Site of Grace to find the path up. The sorcery lies on an altar surrounded by Gravebirds.
whatItIs: Death school sorcery that creates rings of spectral light which fire in unison toward the target. It costs 14 FP for one slot and requires 24 Intelligence plus 18 Faith. The rings deal magic damage while also causing frost buildup on whatever they hit.
whyItMatters: Applying frost alongside magic damage gives the caster two damage channels from a single cast, and the low FP cost keeps it usable throughout long fights. A mid-level intelligence-faith hybrid gets a versatile spell that works at multiple ranges.
whenToUse: Hold the charge until the boss pauses in a recovery window, then release so every ring lands in the same breath. It lives inside the Shadow of the Erdtree content and sits on an altar in Charo's Hidden Grave, reached by heading east from the Site of Grace that faces the Death Rite Bird and climbing the arch.
name: Rings of Spectral Light
effect: Creates rings of spectral light that fire in unison

desc: An incantation of what is jokingly called "the bear communion." Channels the power of Rugalea, the great red bear. Transform oneself into a great red bear and emit a mighty roar. Charging increases potency. An incantation that is more akin to the divine invocation of the hornsent than it is to the Dragon Communion. Only through desperate battle with the feral wild can one discover a god unique to oneself.
location: Guaranteed drop: Rugalea the Great Red Bear Roar of Rugalea is received upon defeating Rugalea in the woods in the northern part of the Rauh Base, northwest of the Ravine North Site of Grace.
whatItIs: Bear communion incantation that channels the power of Rugalea to emit a mighty roar. It costs 17 FP for one slot and needs 14 Faith. Charging increases the potency of the roar before it is released.
whyItMatters: The wide arc of the roar hits everything in front of the caster at once, making it a quick way to clear a room of enemies. A low-investment Faith build gains a simple, effective attack that does not require any special equipment or high stats.
whenToUse: Channel it the moment a cluster of enemies clumps in front or a boss lags mid-teleport. It is part of the Shadow of the Erdtree add-on and drops guaranteed when Rugalea the Great Red Bear falls in the woods in the northern part of the Rauh Base, just northwest of the Ravine North Site of Grace.
name: Roar of Rugalea
effect: Channels great red bear to emit a furious roar

desc: One of the glintstone sorceries of the Academy of Raya Lucaria. Imbues the ferrule of the caster's staff with magic, then thrusts it into the ground to create a massive magical shockwave. Hold to continue moving without striking the ground, and then push the end of the staff into enemies. An enhanced version of the glintstone miners' Stonedigger sorcery.
location: Loot: Caelid Acquired from a corpse in a shed at the upper levels of Sellia Crystal Tunnel.
whatItIs: Glintstone sorcery that imbues the staff's ferrule with magic and thrusts it into the ground to create a massive shockwave. It costs 22 FP for one slot and demands 21 Intelligence. Holding the cast button lets the user walk around without striking the ground, then push the staff into enemies when ready.
whyItMatters: The close-range burst hits everything in a tight radius, which is ideal for finishing off a boss that is already staggered or for clearing a pack that has closed the distance. A mid-level Intelligence build gets a punchy melee-range spell that complements a staff-based playstyle.
whenToUse: Step into the shockwave range when a boss is reeling from a hit and strike, or use the walk-then-push version to approach an enemy and detonate point blank. It is looted in Caelid from a corpse in a shed at the upper levels of Sellia Crystal Tunnel.
name: Rock Blaster
effect: Thrust staff into ground to emit a massive shockwave

desc: One of the glintstone sorceries that manipulates gravitational forces. Pulls a clump of rocks from the earth and sends them flying. This sorcery can be cast while in motion. A gravitational technique studied by the young Radahn. His master was an Alabaster Lord with skin of stone.
location: Loot: Swamp of Aeonia Acquired from a treasure chest found in the cellar of Street of Sages Ruins.
whatItIs: Gravity sorcery that rips a clump of stone from the ground and hurls it at the enemy. It costs very little FP, needs a low Intelligence score, and can be fired mid-dodge, which makes it slot neatly into a roll-then-cast rhythm.
whyItMatters: The projectile is fast and direct, making it a straightforward ranged option for a caster who wants to keep pressure without standing still. A low-to-mid Intelligence build gains a reliable single-target attack early in the game without any complex setup.
whenToUse: Fire it on the move to keep a boss off balance, or lead a fast-moving enemy with the rock's flight path. It is found in a treasure chest in the cellar of Street of Sages Ruins in the Swamp of Aeonia.
name: Rock Sling
effect: Summons rocks from the earth and sends its flying

desc: One of the sorceries developed from the magma of Mt. Gelmir. Fires a lump of condensed magma that explodes a short delay after hitting the target. Charging enhances potency and further delays the explosion. After discovering the ancient hexes of Gelmir, Rykard, son of Queen Rennala, brought them back into practical use as new forms of sorcery.
location: Loot: Mt. Gelmir Acquired from a corpse located in the Hermit's Shack found of the southern side of Mt. Gelmir.
whatItIs: Magma sorcery that fires a lump of condensed magma which explodes after a short delay on impact. It costs 28 FP for one slot and requires 21 Intelligence plus 12 Faith. Charging increases the potency and further delays the explosion.
whyItMatters: The delayed explosion means the damage detonates after the initial hit, catching enemies that try to roll through the impact point. A faith-intelligence hybrid build gets a spell that punishes predictable dodge patterns and hits well in tight spaces.
whenToUse: Fire it at a boss that is standing still or moving slowly, so the delayed blast lands where the target actually is when it goes off. It is looted from a corpse in the Hermit's Shack on the southern side of Mt. Gelmir.
name: Roiling Magma
effect: Fires lump of magma that explodes after delay

desc: One of the incantations of Dragon Communion. Transforms caster into a dragon to spew scarlet rot breath. Charging extends duration. Those extraordinary individuals who perpetuate Dragon Communion are called the dragon-hearted.
location: Dragon Communion: Caelid / Jagged Peak Acquired from the altar at the Cathedral of Dragon Communion in Caelid and the Grand Altar of Dragon Communion on the Jagged Peak for 1 Dragon Heart.
whatItIs: Dragon communion incantation that transforms the caster into a dragon and spews scarlet rot breath. It costs 36 FP for one slot and demands 15 Faith plus 12 Arcane. Charging extends the duration of the breath.
whyItMatters: The rot damage applies a status effect that ticks over time, which is effective against enemies with high physical or elemental resistances. A faith-arcane hybrid build gains a wide breath attack that also applies a damage-over-time effect, useful against stacked enemies.
whenToUse: Aim it at a boss during a recovery animation to maximize the rot ticks before the next phase, or use it against groups to spread the status across multiple targets. It is acquired from the altar at the Cathedral of Dragon Communion in Caelid or the Grand Altar of Dragon Communion on the Jagged Peak, each for 1 Dragon Heart.
name: Rotten Breath
effect: Channels dragon to spew scarlet rot breath

desc: Incantation used by Romina, Saint of the Bud. Summons a myriad of butterflies while performing a gentle twirl. The butterflies break apart on contact, scattering rot and setting off a chain reaction. The scarlet butterflies are as the Goddess of Rot's wings. Bereft of a master, they were soothed by Romina, who reached out to them.
location: Trade: Roundtable Hold Trade the Remembrance of the Saint of the Bud, gained by defeating Romina, Saint of the Bud, with Finger Reader Enia. Alternatively, use one of the Remembrance Duplication Coffins to duplicate one (can only obtain one per playthrough using either method).
whatItIs: Rot incantation that summons a myriad of butterflies which scatter on contact and set off a chain reaction of rot. It costs 48 FP for one slot and demands 33 Faith. The butterflies break apart when they touch an enemy, spreading the effect outward.
whyItMatters: The chain reaction means one butterfly touching a target can trigger additional rot from nearby butterflies, creating a cascading damage zone. A mid-level Faith build gains an area-damage spell that rewards casting it when enemies are clustered together.
whenToUse: Unleash it when a crowd of enemies or a multi-part boss clusters in one tight space, because the chain reaction from breaking butterflies will cascade across every body nearby. Rotten Butterflies comes from the Shadow of the Erdtree expansion. Defeat Romina, Saint of the Bud to receive the Remembrance of the Saint of the Bud, and give that to Finger Reader Enia at Roundtable Hold to learn it.
name: Rotten Butterflies
effect: Summons countless butterflies to scatter rot

desc: The terrible power of Rykard, Lord of Blasphemy. Summons searing spirits that leave a trail of delayed explosions in their wake. These spirits manifest from the rancor of heroes who met a violent end. The lord granted them an audience, whereupon they were welcomed by the maw of the great serpent -- and within the serpent's bowels, they became the lord's kin.
location: Trade the Remembrance of the Blasphemous, dropped by Rykard, Lord of Blasphemy, with Finger Reader Enia. Alternatively, use one of the Wandering Mausoleums with a bell to duplicate one (can only obtain one per playthrough using either method).
whatItIs: Searing spirits summoned from the rancor of fallen heroes, trailing a path of delayed explosions behind them. It costs 23 FP for two slots and demands 40 Intelligence plus 18 Faith. The spirits fly forward and leave explosive markers along their trail.
whyItMatters: The explosion trail stretches well behind the cast point, which punishes any boss that dashes or teleports across the arena. A build that pairs a solid Intelligence base with a dash of Faith gains a zoning tool that forces the fight into a narrower lane.
whenToUse: Fire it across the arena the instant a boss winds up a charge, so the delayed explosions sit in the path it is about to take. It is claimed by handing the Remembrance of the Blasphemous, dropped by Rykard, Lord of Blasphemy, to Finger Reader Enia, or by ringing one of the Wandering Mausoleums.
name: Rykard's Rancor
effect: Releases searing spirits that repeatedly explode after delay

desc: Technique of Malenia, the Goddess of Rot. Creates a gigantic flower that blooms into an explosion of scarlet rot. Each time the scarlet flower blooms, Malenia's rot advances. It has bloomed twice already. With the third bloom, she will become a true goddess.
location: Trade: Roundtable Hold Trade the Remembrance of the Rot Goddess, gained by defeating Malenia, Blade of Miquella, with Finger Reader Enia. Alternatively, use one of the Wandering Mausoleums with a bell to duplicate one (can only obtain one per playthrough using either method).
whatItIs: Rot incantation that conjures a gigantic flower which blooms into an explosion of scarlet rot. It costs 56 FP for three slots and demands 35 Faith. The flower materializes at the target and then erupts, covering a wide area with the rot effect.
whyItMatters: The wide bloom covers a large area and applies scarlet rot, making it a strong answer to enemies that rely on healing or regeneration. A high-Faith build gains a big, slow but devastating area attack that fits well against tough, stationary targets.
whenToUse: Save it for wide-arena bosses where the bloom can open without a wall in the way, and let the rot spread on a target that is already slowed or staggered. It fits late in the game once a Faith build can spare the FP cost for a single heavy hit. To get it, bring the Remembrance of the Rot Goddess to Finger Reader Enia at Roundtable Hold after defeating Malenia, Blade of Miquella, or ring a bell at one of the Wandering Mausoleums to pull a copy.
name: Scarlet Aeonia
effect: Creates a giant flower that explodes with scarlet rot.

desc: One of the glintstone sorceries of the Academy of Raya Lucaria. Enchants armament held in the right hand with magic-affinity attacks. This sorcery can be cast while in motion. Taught to the Knights of the Cuckoo by the academy as payment for their contract.
location: Purchase: Limgrave / Liurnia of the Lakes / Academy of Raya Lucaria / Roundtable Hold Sold for 3,000 Runes by Sorceress Sellen in any of her locations other than Witchbane Ruins. Should Sellen die before purchasing this Sorcery from her, then the player can still purchase it from the Twin Maiden...
whatItIs: Enchants the weapon held in the right hand with magic damage, converting physical hits into glintstone attacks while the effect lasts. It is a Glintstone sorcery that costs 25 FP and needs 12 Intelligence.
whyItMatters: Lets a mixed build apply sorcery scaling to melee strikes without abandoning the weapon, so any character with a few points in Intelligence gets a meaningful damage bump. The cast works while moving, which keeps it out of the way during a combo.
whenToUse: Pop it before any melee fight and let it refresh between encounters. Buy it for 3,000 Runes from Sorceress Sellen in Limgrave, Liurnia of the Lakes, the Academy of Raya Lucaria, or Roundtable Hold; if she dies first, an alternate vendor carries the same spell.
name: Scholar's Armament
effect: Enchants right-hand armament with magic damage

desc: One of the glintstone sorceries of the Academy of Raya Lucaria. Enchants shield held in the left hand with additional damage negation. This sorcery can be cast while in motion. Taught to the Knights of the Cuckoo by the academy as payment for their contract.
location: Purchase: Limgrave / Liurnia of the Lakes / Academy of Raya Lucaria / Roundtable Hold Sold for 2,500 Runes by Sorceress Sellen in any of her locations other than Witchbane Ruins. Should Sellen die before purchasing this Sorcery from her, then the player can still purchase it from the Twin Maiden...
whatItIs: A left-hand buff that raises the damage negation of the equipped shield for the duration of the effect. It is a Glintstone sorcery that costs 30 FP and needs 12 Intelligence.
whyItMatters: Turns a mid-tier shield into a much sturdier blocker, which is useful for any build that leans on parries or simply wants to take fewer hits from heavy attacks. It can be cast while moving, so it does not break the rhythm of dodging.
whenToUse: Equip it before clashing with a boss that telegraphs heavy strikes, since it boosts the damage a left-hand shield absorbs while moving. Pick it up from Sorceress Sellen, who stocks it at her shop in Limgrave, at the Academy of Raya Lucaria in Liurnia of the Lakes, or at Roundtable Hold; if she is gone an alternate vendor will still sell it.
name: Scholar's Shield
effect: Enhances left-handed shield damage negation

desc: A black flame incantation of the Godskin Apostles. Sweeps a wide area before the caster with black flame. Charging enhances range. The black flame could once slay gods. But when Maliketh sealed Destined Death, the true power of the black flame was lost.
location: Guaranteed Drop: Altus Plateau Scouring Black Flame is received upon defeating the Godskin Apostle at Dominula, Windmill Village, on the Altus Plateau.
whatItIs: Sweeps a wide arc of black flame in front of the caster, dealing damage and applying a lingering effect. It is a black flame incantation that costs 21 FP and needs 28 Faith; holding the cast extends the range.
whyItMatters: The wide arc covers a generous area in front of the character, making it a reliable pressure tool against enemies that close in or against bosses that telegraph a heavy attack. A Faith build picks it up early as a solid area-damage option that does not demand precise aiming.
whenToUse: Cast it when an enemy is at medium range or when a boss finishes a big move and there is an opening to punish. It drops from the Godskin Apostle at Dominula, Windmill Village, on the Altus Plateau.
name: Scouring Black Flame
effect: Sweeps area before caster with black flame

desc: Incantation of the Two Fingers' servants, who once served as the assassins of the Roundtable Hold. Creates a pale gold shadow before the caster, luring foes of human build and attracting their aggression. This incantation can be cast while in motion or crouching, and will still affect foes that are already in a combat state. It is said that those beguiled by the shadow see within it a hated foe.
location: Loot: Subterranean Shunning-Grounds Shadow Bait is found on a corpse guarded by an Omen, past the large gate to the right of the Underground Roadside Site of Grace. If the gate is locked, take the ladder ahead and to the left of the Grace, then continue to the doorway on the far right of the...
whatItIs: Splits off a pale gold shadow ahead of the caster that draws the attention of humanoid enemies. It is a Two Fingers incantation that costs 15 FP and needs 13 Faith.
whyItMatters: It acts as a free aggro-pull, letting a caster or a stealth-leaning build walk away from a pack while the shadow soaks hits. Because it works even on enemies already in combat, it is handy for peeling off a chaser mid-fight.
whenToUse: Use it when a group of humanoid enemies locks onto the character and a clean escape is needed. It is found on a corpse in the Subterranean Shunning-Grounds, guarded by an Omen past the large gate to the right of the Underground Roadside Site of Grace.
name: Shadow Bait
effect: Creates shadow that lures the aggression of foes of human build

desc: One of the glintstone sorceries of the Academy of Raya Lucaria. Fires twin projectiles that form a spiral as they travel. This sorcery can be cast repeatedly and while in motion. Charging enhances potency. A sorcery of the Karolos conspectus, the most venerable of the academy. This was the product of a failed attempt to create a new comet.
location: Quest Item/ Purchase: Academy of Raya Lucaria Sold for 8,000 Runes by Sorceress Sellen after choosing to side with her and help her vanquish Witch-Hunter Jerren at the Raya Lucaria Grand Library. Should Sellen die before this point in her questline, then this Sorcery will be left unavailable for...
whatItIs: Twin projectiles launch from the staff and spiral outward as they travel, covering a growing arc. It is a Glintstone sorcery that costs 14 FP and needs 27 Intelligence; charging the cast boosts potency.
whyItMatters: The spiral pattern makes it forgiving to land on moving targets, which suits a mid-game caster who wants reliable hits without pixel-perfect aim. A pure Intelligence build slots it as a safe, repeatable attack that works while strafing.
whenToUse: Fire it at enemies that strafe or dodge in wide arcs, and hold the cast briefly for extra damage on slower targets. Sorceress Sellen sells it for 8,000 Runes in the Academy of Raya Lucaria after the character helps her vanquish Witch-Hunter Jerren at the Raya Lucaria Grand Library.
name: Shard Spiral
effect: Fire twin spiraling projectiles

desc: One of the glintstone sorceries of the Academy of Raya Lucaria. Imbues the ferrule of the caster's staff with magic, then thrusts it into the ground to create a magical shockwave. Allows one follow-up attack. A Stonedigger sorcery used by the glintstone miners of the crystal tunnel. At the academy, use of this sorcery was a stigma that marked out failed scholars.
location: Loot: Liurnia Acquired from a corpse in the section just before the final elevator of Raya Lucaria Crystal Tunnel.
whatItIs: Thrusts the staff into the ground and emits a magical shockwave that knocks back nearby enemies. It is a Glintstone sorcery that costs 10 FP and needs 15 Intelligence.
whyItMatters: The knockback creates space in tight corridors and can interrupt a melee enemy's combo, which is valuable when a caster is cornered. It also allows one follow-up attack, giving a short burst window after the initial hit lands.
whenToUse: Pop it when several enemies close in at once or when a boss is mid-lunge and needs to be broken off. It is found on a corpse in Liurnia, in the section just before the final elevator of the Raya Lucaria Crystal Tunnel.
name: Shatter Earth
effect: Thrust staff into ground to emit a shockwave

desc: Sorcery of the mysterious Crystalians. Creates a mass of crystal, then shatters it in a forward burst. Charging enhances potency. The Crystalians are inorganic beings, yet they live. They cleave close to the ideals of the primeval current, and as such, they are revered guests of the sorcerers.
location: Loot: Academy of Raya Lucaria Acquired from a corpse located on the second floor of the Church of the Cuckoo. The second floor can be accessed through careful platforming on the rooftops west of the plaza north of the Debate Parlor Site of Grace.
whatItIs: A crystal mass forms in front of the caster and then bursts outward in a wide forward spread. It is a Glintstone sorcery that costs 32 FP and needs 38 Intelligence; holding the cast increases potency.
whyItMatters: The forward burst covers a generous cone, making it a strong zoning tool against groups that cluster together. A high-Intelligence build wants it as a medium-range answer when several enemies close the gap at once.
whenToUse: Cast it when a group is within medium range and the character needs to clear them without closing to melee distance. It is on a corpse on the second floor of the Church of the Cuckoo in the Academy of Raya Lucaria, reached by platforming across rooftops west of the plaza north of the Debate Parlor Site of Grace.
name: Shattering Crystal
effect: Creates crystal mass that shatters in forward burst

desc: Superior incantation of Dragon Communion. Channels the power of Smarag, the Glintstone Dragon. Transforms caster into a dragon to spew magic breath from above. Charging extends duration. This incantation can be cast while jumping. Smarag was a devourer of sorcerers, and over time, his body became corrupted by their glintstones.
location: Dragon Communion: Caelid / Jagged Peak Acquired from the altar at the Cathedral of Dragon Communion in Caelid for 2 Dragon Hearts after defeating Glintstone Dragon Smarag north of Temple Quarter in Liurnia.
whatItIs: Transforms the caster into a dragon and spews a long stream of glintstone breath downward and forward. It is a dragon incantation that costs 36 FP and needs 23 Faith and 15 Arcane; charging the cast extends the duration.
whyItMatters: The breath covers a large area in front and below the character, which is useful for clearing crowds or pressuring a boss that keeps backing away. A Faith-Arcane build values it for the combination of range, coverage, and magic damage type.
whenToUse: Cast it from an elevated position or while jumping so the breath rains down on enemies below. It is acquired from the altar at the Cathedral of Dragon Communion in Caelid for 2 Dragon Hearts, after defeating Glintstone Dragon Smarag north of Temple Quarter in Liurnia.
name: Smarag's Glintstone Breath
effect: Spews magic breath of Glintstone Dragon Smarag from above

desc: Superior sorcery of the tower priests, wielded as an incantation of the spiral. Wrap one's arms together and hold them up to the heavens to summon a spiral of light that erupts at the enemy's feet. Column of light persists for as long as the button is pressed. The spiral is a normalized Crucible current that, one day, will form a column that stretches to the gods.
location: Loot: Enir-Ilim. From the First Rise Site of Grace, pass the fountain surrounded by Inquisitors and go up the stairs. Thereafter, find a way to walk on the branches to cross over to the platform with the single praying Inquisitor.
whatItIs: Sums a column of light that erupts at the feet of the target enemy and persists while the button is held. It is an incantation that costs 10 FP, takes 2 slots, and needs 48 Faith.
whyItMatters: It pins an enemy in place and deals damage over the duration, which is a strong control tool against bosses that rely on dodging to avoid hits. A high-Faith build uses it to set up combos or to keep a fast enemy locked in one spot.
whenToUse: This one requires the Shadow of the Erdtree expansion. Cast it when a boss is locked into a pattern and the character needs to interrupt the rhythm. It is found in Enir-Ilim, past the fountain surrounded by Inquisitors, on a platform reached by crossing tree branches from the stairs after the First Rise Site of Grace.
name: Spira
effect: Summons a spiral of light that erupts at the enemy's feet

desc: One of the glintstone sorceries of the Academy of Raya Lucaria. Fires six magic shooting stars that pursue the target. This sorcery can be cast while in motion. Charging enhances potency. The most difficult to master of the Olivinus Conspectus sorceries.
location: Purchase: Limgrave / Liurnia of the Lakes / Academy of Raya Lucaria / Roundtable Hold Sold for 10,000 Runes by Sorceress Sellen, Miriel, Pastor of Vows or Preceptor Seluvis after giving either of them the Conspectus Scroll. Should the scroll be given to one of them and then have that instructor...
whatItIs: Looses six magic shooting stars that home in on the target after release. It is a Glintstone sorcery that costs 23 FP and needs 24 Intelligence; charging boosts potency.
whyItMatters: The homing behavior makes it very forgiving to land, which suits a caster who struggles with manual aim or is fighting fast-moving enemies. A mid-tier Intelligence build slots it as a reliable all-purpose attack that still tracks its target.
whenToUse: Cast it against bosses that dash in wide arcs or when a horde scatters, since each star homes in on a separate target. After the Conspectus Scroll goes to Sorceress Sellen, Miriel, Pastor of Vows, or Preceptor Seluvis, it appears in their stock in Limgrave, at Roundtable Hold, or across Liurnia of the Lakes.
name: Star Shower
effect: Fires six shooting stars that pursue foes

desc: One of the glintstone sorceries of the Academy of Raya Lucaria. Creates a small, floating star light that illuminates surroundings. This sorcery can be cast while in motion. Granted to sorcerers who depart from the academy to embark on journeys. Even during the blackest nights, sojourns underground, or imprisonment in gaol, the stars are never far from a sorcerer's side.
location: Purchase: Liurnia of the Lakes / Roundtable Hold Sold for 2,500 Runes by Sorcerer Thops at the Church of Irith. Should Thops die before purchasing this Sorcery from him, then the player can still purchase it from the Twin Maiden Husks for the same price, after giving them Thops's Bell Bearing.
whatItIs: Sends a small floating star of light that illuminates the surrounding area for a sustained period. It is a Glintstone sorcery that costs 9 FP and needs 15 Intelligence.
whyItMatters: Dark areas are dangerous because ambushes are invisible, and a light source removes that uncertainty before it becomes a problem. Any build benefits from it in pitch-black caves or underground sections where enemies wait in the dark.
whenToUse: Cast it before entering any dark corridor or cave so the path ahead is visible. Sorcerer Thops sells it for 2,500 Runes at the Church of Irith in Liurnia of the Lakes, or from the Twin Maiden Husks in Roundtable Hold after giving them Thops's Bell Bearing if Thops dies first.
name: Starlight
effect: Creates star light to illuminate surroundings

desc: Legendary sorcery devised by Lusat, primeval sorcerers. Fires twelve dark shooting stars that pursue the target. This sorcery can be cast while in motion. Charging increases potency. When Lusat glimpsed into the primeval current, he beheld the final moments of a great star cluster, and upon seeing it, he too was broken.
location: Quest Item: Caelid Acquired from Primeval Sorcerer Lusat in Sellia Hideaway. Requires the Sellian Sealbreaker from Sellen in order to access him.
whatItIs: Fires twelve dark shooting stars that pursue the target across a wide spread. It is a Primeval sorcery that costs 32 FP and needs 43 Intelligence; charging increases potency.
whyItMatters: The high projectile count and homing make it a devastating burst against a single large target that is trying to keep its distance. A maxed Intelligence build wants it as a finisher or a burst-damage option on tough bosses that resist shorter attacks.
whenToUse: Hold the cast for maximum damage and fire it when a boss is exposed after a big attack animation. It is acquired from Primeval Sorcerer Lusat in Sellia Hideaway, Caelid, but requires the Sellian Sealbreaker from Sellen to gain access to him.
name: Stars of Ruin
effect: Fires twelve dark shooting stars that pursue foes

desc: Superior incantation taught by Gurranq, the Beast Clergyman. Hurls a boulder before the caster. This incantation can be cast repeatedly. Long ago, Gurranq was a beast of such terrifying ferocity that his former name meant "Death of the Demigods."
location: Quest Item: Bestial Sanctum, Greyoll's Dragonbarrow Stone of Gurranq is rewarded from Gurranq after giving him the sixth Deathroot. (However, only after Gurranq has been calmed down after he turns hostile on the player's return to him after consuming the fourth Deathroot.)
whatItIs: A bestial incantation taught by Gurranq, the Beast Clergyman, that hurls a heavy boulder forward in a short arc. It asks for only a modest amount of Faith and a small FP cost, and it can be cast repeatedly without a long recovery between throws.
whyItMatters: The splash damage and the fact that it can be cast repeatedly make it a solid crowd-control and area-damage tool for a low-Faith build. It does not demand high stats, so even a hybrid character can slot it without much investment.
whenToUse: Pop it at groups of enemies or at a boss's feet to break positioning and create space. Gurranq, the Beast Clergyman, rewards it after receiving the sixth Deathroot in the Bestial Sanctum at Greyoll's Dragonbarrow, but only after he has been calmed following the fourth Deathroot.
name: Stone of Gurranq
effect: Hurls a boulder before the caster

desc: Superior incantation of the Fire Monks. Creates a stream of fire to burn the area before the caster. This incantation can be cast while in motion. Hold to maintain the effect. The Giants' Flame is the flame of ruin, capable of burning the Erdtree. And so, following the War against the Giants, its ruinous blaze was sealed, and guardians were appointed to watch over it.
location: Purchase: Roundtable Hold / Liurnia of the Lakes / Altus Plateau / Leyndell, Royal Capital / Mountaintops of the Giants Sold for 5,500 Runes by Brother Corhyn or Miriel, Pastor of Vows after giving either of them the Fire Monks' Prayerbook. Should the prayerbook be given to one of them and then...
whatItIs: Ejects a sustained stream of fire from the caster's hands, burning everything in the cone ahead. It is a Giantsflame incantation that costs just 1 FP and needs 9 Faith; holding the button keeps the stream going.
whyItMatters: The near-zero FP cost means it is always available, making it a reliable fallback for any Faith build that is running low on resources. It covers a generous cone and is effective against groups or against a single enemy that is standing still in the blast.
whenToUse: Hold it while an enemy is in the cone, especially after a dodge or parry creates an opening. Brother Corhyn or Miriel, Pastor of Vows each sell it for 5,500 Runes after receiving the Fire Monks' Prayerbook, available in Roundtable Hold, Liurnia of the Lakes, Altus Plateau, Leyndell, Royal Capital, or Mountaintops of the Giants.
name: Surge, O Flame!
effect: Incinerates area before caster with stream of fire

desc: A Blood Oath incantation, shared from the Lord of Blood's power. Releases a swarm of bloodflies before the caster to assault foes. The vile swarm deals damage and builds up onset of blood loss. This incantation can be cast while in motion. The new palace of the Lord of Blood lies in a swamp of festering blood, and these flies are said to spawn from excrement in that land.
location: Loot: Mohgwyn Palace Located on a corpse at the end of one of the caves found in the northeastern quarter of the lake of blood.
whatItIs: Releases a cloud of bloodflies ahead of the caster that swarms the target and builds up blood loss. It is a blood incantation that costs 14 FP and needs 11 Faith and 16 Arcane.
whyItMatters: The blood loss buildup it applies can trigger a large burst on bosses with high HP, and the flies are hard to dodge because they track the target. A Faith-Arcane build wants it as a damage-over-time option that also pressures the target's health pool.
whenToUse: Cast it on a boss during a vulnerable phase to stack blood loss while landing follow-up hits. It is on a corpse at the end of one of the caves in the northeastern quarter of the lake of blood in Mohgwyn Palace.
name: Swarm of Flies
effect: Releases a swarm of bloodflies before the caster

desc: One of the glintstone sorceries of the Academy of Raya Lucaria. The glintstone serves as a conduit, launching swift magical projectiles at foes. This sorcery can be used without delay after performing another action. Those unworthy of the stone crown typically end their brief journey into sorcery here.
location: Purchase: Limgrave / Liurnia of the Lakes / Academy of Raya Lucaria / Roundtable Hold Sold for 600 Runes by Sorceress Sellen, Miriel, Pastor of Vows or Preceptor Seluvis after giving either of them the Academy Scroll. Should the scroll be given to one of them and then have that instructor die...
whatItIs: Fires a quick, low-cost magic projectile from the glintstone in the caster's hand. It is a Glintstone sorcery that costs only 5 FP and needs 12 Intelligence.
whyItMatters: The speed and the tiny FP cost make it a safe first spell for any new caster, since mistakes are cheap to repeat and the rhythm stays smooth. It can be cast without delay after another action, which keeps the flow of combat unbroken.
whenToUse: Equip it in the first stretch of the game because the FP cost is so low that rapid casting teaches rhythm without penalty, and the projectile leaves the moment the key is tapped. Give the Academy Scroll to Sorceress Sellen, or to Miriel, Pastor of Vows, or to Preceptor Seluvis, and it appears on a shelf at Roundtable Hold, in Limgrave, or across Liurnia of the Lakes.
name: Swift Glintstone Shard
effect: Swiftly fires magic projectiles from glintstone

desc: One of the glintstone sorceries of the Academy of Raya Lucaria. Draws an academy sigil upon the ground, raising the magic strength of those within. Once, the sigil would be cast from the highest belfry of the academy, covering the entire institution's grounds. This spell allows such vivid experience of spell—casting success, it turns many a fledgling into a true sorcerer in a flash of newfound understanding.
location: Loot: Academy Crystal Cave After defeating the boss, there is an elevator that leads up to the bell tower of the Academy of Raya Lucaria. Ascend the stairs and the spell will be inside a chest.
whatItIs: Draws an academy sigil on the ground and raises the magic strength of whoever stands inside it. It is a Glintstone sorcery that costs 20 FP and needs 20 Intelligence.
whyItMatters: The buff multiplies every sorcery cast while standing in the circle, which is a meaningful damage increase for any caster build in a long fight. It is especially useful before a boss encounter where sustained spell output decides the outcome.
whenToUse: Drop it before a tough duel and keep standing inside the circle for as long as the fight lasts, since the buff only applies while the caster is within the sigil. To find it, defeat the boss in the Academy Crystal Cave, ride the elevator up to the bell tower of the Academy of Raya Lucaria, and open the chest at the top of the stairs.
name: Terra Magicus
effect: Raises the magic strength of those within the sigil

desc: Incantation originating from the maddening Three Fingers. The flame of frenzy deals damage and causes buildup of madness. This incantation also causes buildup of madness in the caster, and is only effective against Tarnished.
location: Loot: Callu Baptismal Church (Weeping Peninsula) Found on a corpse in the middle of the church, near the Frenzied Flame Village, located in the middle of the Weeping Peninsula.
whatItIs: Bursts from the caster's eyes as a short-range explosion of yellow flame that deals damage and builds up madness. It is a frenzy incantation that costs 16 FP and needs 16 Faith; it also applies madness to the caster.
whyItMatters: It deals madness buildup, a damage type that certain enemies in the game are weak to, which gives a Faith build a direct answer against them. The self-madness cost means the caster must manage their own sanity while the effect is active.
whenToUse: Aim it at close range at any Tarnished enemy, because the madness it builds up is the real damage here, but be prepared for the caster to accumulate some madness too. The Flame of Frenzy sits on a corpse in the middle of Callu Baptismal Church (Weeping Peninsula), just before the road to the Frenzied Flame Village.
name: The Flame of Frenzy
effect: Emits burst of yellow flame of frenzy from eyes

desc: Superior incantation of Dragon Communion. Channels the power of the great wyrm Theodorix. Transforms caster into a great wyrm to spew a large volume of magma breath. Allows one follow-up attack. The name of the ancient troll warrior Theodorix lives on — as a hero of the War against the Giants.
location: Dragon Communion: Limgrave / Caelid / Jagged Peak Acquired from the altar at the Church of Dragon Communion in Limgrave, the Cathedral of Dragon Communion in Caelid, and the Grand Altar of Dragon Communion on the Jagged Peak for 2 Dragon Hearts after defeating Great Wyrm Theodorix in Consecrated...
whatItIs: Channels the power of a great wyrm and spews a large volume of magma breath forward from an elevated stance. It is a dragon incantation that costs 45 FP and needs 21 Faith and 14 Arcane; it allows one follow-up attack.
whyItMatters: The breath covers a large area and the follow-up attack adds a bonus hit, making it a strong burst option for a Faith-Arcane build. It is especially effective against enemies that group together or against a boss standing in one place.
whenToUse: Cast it from an elevated position or right before a boss telegraphs a heavy attack. It is acquired for 2 Dragon Hearts from the altar at the Church of Dragon Communion in Limgrave, the Cathedral of Dragon Communion in Caelid, or the Grand Altar of Dragon Communion on the Jagged Peak, after defeating Great Wyrm Theodorix.
name: Theodorix's Magma
effect: Spews magma breath of Theodorix from above

desc: The lifelong pursuit of Thops the Bluntstone. Creates a magic forcefield that deflects sorceries and incantations. Hold to continuously create barriers. Future generations will learn. They will know the foolishness of the sneering sorcerers who ridiculed this theory, little realizing that it was in fact a discovery worthy of a new conspectus of the academy.
location: Quest Item / Loot: Academy of Raya Lucaria Acquired from the body of Thops located outside the Schoolhouse Classroom after giving him the spare Academy Glintstone Key.
whatItIs: Projects a wall of magic force that deflects incoming sorceries and incantations for as long as the button is held. It is a Glintstone sorcery that costs 7 FP and needs 18 Intelligence.
whyItMatters: It negates enemy spell damage while active, which is a lifesaver against caster-type bosses that chain projectiles at the character. Any build, not just casters, benefits from the damage reduction it provides in a pinch.
whenToUse: Hold it up while a caster-type enemy is channeling a big spell or while dodging through a volley of projectiles. It is found on the body of Thops located outside the Schoolhouse Classroom in the Academy of Raya Lucaria, after giving him the spare Academy Glintstone Key.
name: Thops's Barrier
effect: Erects a magic forcefield to deflect spells

desc: Sorcery of the servants of Death. Summons a group of Those Lost in Death. Three skeletons will appear some distance from the caster and attack foes before disappearing. The dead have long been left to wander; what they need is leadership.
location: Drop: Wyndham Ruins (Altus Plateau) From the Tibia Mariner miniboss rowing through the waters.
whatItIs: A Death-school sorcery that calls three skeletal figures into being some distance ahead. They charge toward whatever is nearby and trade blows before fading away. It costs 17 FP and needs 28 Intelligence with 20 Faith.
whyItMatters: Free damage without spending a hit of the caster's own health makes it useful when facing multiple enemies at once or as a burst tool in tight spaces. A hybrid Int/Fai build that already runs Death sorceries will slot it in naturally.
whenToUse: Drop it on grouped enemies in the Altus Plateau area or use it to buy a moment of breathing room against a boss. The spell is dropped by the Tibia Mariner miniboss rowing through the waters in Wyndham Ruins on the Altus Plateau.
name: Tibia's Summons
effect: Summons Those Who Live in Death

desc: One of the incantations of the Golden Order fundamentalists. Produces three rings of light and fires them forwards. The rings of light return to a position close to the caster before disappearing. This incantation can be cast repeatedly. A gift from the young Miquella to his father, Radagon.
location: Loot: Elphael, Brace of the Haligtree Found in a treasure chest in a room locked by an Imp Statue located at the lower level near the Prayer Room Site of Grace.
whatItIs: Casting it sends three rings of light forward, and they travel out before returning toward the caster in a short arc. It is a Golden Order incantation that costs 23 FP and asks for 23 Intelligence alongside 23 Faith.
whyItMatters: The round-trip shape lets it hit enemies in front and behind in a single press, which is handy in narrow corridors or against enemies that flank. A Faith-Int hybrid build looking for reliable single-target pressure gets a clean answer here.
whenToUse: Use it against single targets in tight spaces or to punish enemies that lunge close. It sits in a treasure chest in a room locked by an Imp Statue at the lower level near the Prayer Room Site of Grace in Elphael, Brace of the Haligtree.
name: Triple Rings of Light
effect: Fire three rings of light before the caster

desc: Incantation originating from the maddening Three Fingers. Causes the yellow flame of frenzy to violently burst forth from the caster's eyes. Hold to continue channeling the flame. This incantation can be used while in motion. It is the maddening pain and unstoppable tears of those afflicted with the flame of frenzy brought into being.
location: Loot: Yelough Anix Ruins (Consecrated Snowfield) Found in a cellar located in the small, westernmost building in the southern clusters of the ruins, the ones closest to the Yelough Anix Tunnel.
whatItIs: Holding the button projects a widening cone of yellow flame from the caster's eyes while the character moves forward. It is a chargeable Frenzy incantation that costs 22 FP and demands 31 Faith.
whyItMatters: The ability to channel while walking makes it a strong mobility spell for clearing rooms of weaker enemies in one pass. A pure Faith build with room in the FP pool can weave it between melee engagements.
whenToUse: Sprint through a corridor of enemies with it held down to burn the group in one pass. The spell is found in a cellar inside the small, westernmost building in the southern clusters of Yelough Anix Ruins on the Consecrated Snowfield, the ones closest to the Yelough Anix Tunnel.
name: Unendurable Frenzy
effect: Emits violent burst of yellow flame of frenzy from eyes

desc: One of the night sorceries of Sellia, Town of Sorcery. Enchants armament held in right hand, making it completely invisible. This sorcery can be cast while in motion. Used by Sellian assassins to present themselves as unarmed sorcerers.
location: Loot: Altus Plateau Acquired from the treasure chest at the top of Mirage Rise.
whatItIs: A Night-school sorcery that makes the weapon in the right hand completely invisible while leaving the caster fully visible. It costs 18 FP and only needs 12 Intelligence, so nearly any caster can run it. It can be cast while moving.
whyItMatters: Backstab and riposte builds gain a free setup because the enemy no longer reads the weapon as a threat. A low-Int caster who has not yet stacked stats high can still use it without stretching the build.
whenToUse: Equip it before sneaking up on an enemy from behind or lining up a riposte after a parry. It is in a treasure chest at the top of Mirage Rise on the Altus Plateau.
name: Unseen Blade
effect: Makes right-hand armament completely invisible

desc: One of the night sorceries of Sellia, Town of Sorcery. Makes the caster semi-invisible. While on horseback, effect extends to cover the mount. This sorcery can be cast while in motion. The Sellian assassins considered every option that aided their dirty work.
location: Loot: Altus Plateau Acquired from the treasure chest at the top of Mirage Rise.
whatItIs: Semi-invisibility is the core effect, and on horseback the illusion extends to cover the mount as well. A Night-school sorcery from Sellia, it costs 20 FP and requires 16 Intelligence. Casting works even while the character is on the move.
whyItMatters: A free opening move that drops aggro or lets a caster walk past a patrol without fighting. A low-Int build can grab it early without any stat penalty, and the stealth setup pairs well with backstab-focused weapon choices.
whenToUse: Cast it before approaching a group of enemies or to bypass a patrol that would otherwise block a path. Pick it up from the chest at the top of Mirage Rise, the same spot where Unseen Blade is kept.
name: Unseen Form
effect: Makes the caster semi-invisible

desc: Incantation of the Two Fingers' faithful. Heals a small amount of HP. This incantation can be cast while in motion. The Two Fingers has high hopes for the Tarnished; that even if they should be wounded, even should they fall, they will continue to fight for their duty.
location: Equipped: Urgent Heal is a starting spell for the Confessor origin. Purchase: Roundtable Hold / Altus Plateau / Leyndell, Royal Capital / Mountaintops of the Giants Urgent Heal is sold for 1,000 Runes by Brother Corhyn. Should Corhyn die before purchasing this incantation from him, the player...
whatItIs: Urgent Heal is a simple Two Fingers incantation that restores a small amount of HP in an instant. It costs 16 FP and needs only 8 Faith. It can be cast while in motion.
whyItMatters: A Faith build that does not yet carry a stronger heal keeps a safety net without spending a high-cost slot. The low Faith requirement means almost any incantation user can slot it as a stopgap.
whenToUse: Cast it mid-combat when HP dips and a Flask is not yet available or desired. It is a starting spell for the Confessor origin, and Brother Corhyn in Roundtable Hold sells it for 1,000 Runes, with copies also available at shops in Altus Plateau, Leyndell, Royal Capital, and Mountaintops of the Giants.
name: Urgent Heal
effect: Heals a small amount of HP

desc: Sorcery used by the Putrescent Knight. Launches a whirl of putrescent jets that explode shortly after impact and bathe the area in ghostflame. In an age long past, Death was burned by ghostflame. Even the remains of tainted flesh were given equal treatment in death.
location: Trade the Remembrance of Putrescence with Finger Reader Enia.
whatItIs: The Putrescent Knight's signature sorcery launches a swirling cluster of putrescent jets that explode on impact and leave a lingering field of ghostflame behind. It is a Death-school sorcery costing 29 FP across two slots, and it asks for 32 Intelligence with 26 Faith.
whyItMatters: The area-denial from the ghostflame field makes it a strong tool against enemies that close to melee range. A hybrid Int/Fai caster looking for zone control against groups finds a clean fit here.
whenToUse: Drop it on a cluster of enemies to force them out of position, then follow up with a direct-damage sorcery. It requires the Shadow of the Erdtree expansion and is obtained by trading the Remembrance of Putrescence to Finger Reader Enia.
name: Vortex of Putrescence
effect: Launches a whirl of putrescent jets

desc: Incantation of Vyke, knight of the Roundtable Hold. Summons red lightning to bolster both the caster's body and their armament held in the right hand. Enchants armament with lightning-affinity attacks and increases maximum equipment load. However, lightning damage negation will be reduced. Of all the knights, Vyke the Dragonspear was the one Lansseax loved the most.
location: Guaranteed Drop: Mountaintops of the Giants Vyke's Dragonbolt is acquired from the defeat of Roundtable Knight Vyke in the Lord Contender's Evergaol.
whatItIs: Vyke's own signature buff enchants the right-hand weapon with lightning damage and raises the caster's maximum equipment load. It is a Dragon Cult incantation costing 27 FP that needs 23 Faith. Lightning damage negation drops while the effect is active.
whyItMatters: A melee-focused Faith build gets both a damage buff and a load-cap increase in one cast, making heavy armor viable without separate load-boosting gear. The lightning affinity also changes how the weapon interacts with enemy resistances.
whenToUse: Cast it before a boss fight when the weapon already has good base damage and the extra lightning scaling pushes total output up. It is a guaranteed drop from defeating Roundtable Knight Vyke in the Lord Contender's Evergaol on the Mountaintops of the Giants.
name: Vyke's Dragonbolt
effect: Enchants right-hand armament with lightning damage

desc: An entreaty received from the hornsent grandam. Summon a guardian spirit above the caster's head. The spirit never strays far from the caster, conjuring several apparitions before dissipating. "Take vengeance upon Messmer and his lot. They who betrayed us, aye, they who burned us... Let them face in thy wrath their just deserts."
location: Loot: Belurat, Tower Settlement Gained by speaking to the Hornsent Grandam twice while wearing the Divine Beast Head. She can be found by exiting the room with the Small Private Altar Site of Grace and taking a left to walk across a thin bridge to find a locked door that requires the Storeroom...
whatItIs: An incantation that calls a guardian spirit to hover above the caster's head, where it conjures several apparitions that strike nearby foes. It belongs to the Divine Beast school, costs 12 FP, and requires 26 Faith.
whyItMatters: The low FP cost makes it a cheap source of supplemental damage that never leaves the caster's side. A Faith build that wants passive pressure without spending a big cast slot gets a simple answer.
whenToUse: Equip it in long boss fights where the spirit's apparitions keep chipping damage while the caster focuses on dodging. Owning the Shadow of the Erdtree expansion is a prerequisite for learning it. Find the Hornsent Grandam in Belurat, Tower Settlement, wear the Divine Beast Head, and speak with her twice to receive it.
name: Watchful Spirit
effect: Summons a guardian spirit above the caster's head

desc: Superior incantation of the Fire Monks. Creates a spiraling stream of fire that burns the area before the caster. Charging enhances potency and reach. Fire beguiles those who gaze into it. And so the guardians of the Flame are also its worshippers.
location: Loot: Caelid Dropped by a Teardrop Scarab in northern Caelid, between the Caelem Ruins and the Rotview Balcony sites of grace. The scarab is located right behind the black carriage containing the Greatsword.
whatItIs: A channeling Giantsflame incantation that sweeps a spiraling stream of fire across the ground in front of the caster. Charging it extends both the potency and the reach of the flame. It costs 19 FP and needs 13 Faith.
whyItMatters: The wide ground sweep makes it a strong answer to groups of enemies that rush the caster from multiple directions. A mid-range Faith build can use it to control space without committing to a single-target spell.
whenToUse: Hold it while retreating to create a wall of fire between the caster and a pursuing group, or charge it fully to clear a room of weaker foes. It is dropped by a Teardrop Scarab in northern Caelid, between the Caelem Ruins and the Rotview Balcony sites of grace, right behind the black carriage containing the Greatsword.
name: Whirl, O Flame!
effect: Sweeps area before caster with stream of fire

desc: An Erdtree incantation discovered in the realm of shadow. Fires a golden shockwave that knocks back nearby foes. Charging increases the size of the shockwave. When the Elden Ring was shattered, the people of the realm of shadow felt it too – and feared it as a sign of the Erdtree's wrath.
location: Loot: Shadow Keep Found at the Specimen Storehouse in the Storehouse Loft on one of the giant cogs.
whatItIs: Firing it releases a golden shockwave that knocks back nearby enemies, and holding the button increases the size of the wave. It is an Erdtree-school incantation that costs 18 FP and demands 34 Faith.
whyItMatters: Knockback control is rare among incantations, and this one delivers it at a moderate FP cost. A Faith build facing a boss that telegraphs a devastating close-range attack can use the knockback to break the rhythm.
whenToUse: Use it the moment a nearby enemy lunges in, letting the golden shockwave knock them back and buy room to reposition. The Shadow of the Erdtree expansion must be present before it can be found. Head to Shadow Keep, climb to the Storehouse Loft where the giant cogs turn, and pick it up from the Specimen Storehouse.
name: Wrath from Afar
effect: Fires a golden shockwave that knocks back foes

desc: Superior Erdtree Worship incantation. Produces a golden shockwave that knocks back nearby foes. Charging increases the size of the shockwave. This incantation was discovered when the Elden Ring was shattered, and it was feared as a sign of the Erdtree's wrath.
location: Loot: Altus Plateau Found in a treasure chest in the cellar of Woodfolk Ruins. The cellar is located in a cluster of ruins in the southeasternmost quarter of the forest.
whatItIs: An Erdtree Worship incantation that produces a golden shockwave, knocking back every foe caught in the radius. Charging the cast enlarges the shockwave before it releases. It costs 40 FP and requires 32 Faith.
whyItMatters: The high knockback value makes it a crowd-control anchor for any Faith build that faces groups of enemies. The long FP cost means it is a deliberate choice rather than a spam tool, best saved for a specific moment.
whenToUse: Use it to break a boss's attack string or to scatter a pack of enemies that have closed the gap. It is in a treasure chest in the cellar of Woodfolk Ruins on the Altus Plateau, in the southeasternmost quarter of the forest.
name: Wrath of Gold
effect: Produces golden shockwave that knocks back foes

desc: Ice sorcery of the Town of Zamor. Strike the ground with the staff to create a freezing tornado. Charging enhances potency. Cloaked in icy tempests, the knights of Zamor have challenged the Fire Giants since ancient times.
location: Loot: Mountaintops of the Giants Acquired from a corpse lying next to a wall in the southernmost quarters of the Zamor Ruins.
whatItIs: Thrusting the staff into the ground spawns a freezing tornado at the target point that lingers and batters whatever passes through it. It is a chargeable Cold-school sorcery from the Town of Zamor with a solid Intelligence requirement. Charging enhances its potency.
whyItMatters: The lingering slow effect gives a caster time to reposition or line up a follow-up spell without the target closing. A high-Int build that wants a zone-control tool with a low FP cost gets a reliable option here.
whenToUse: Drop it at a boss's feet after they lunge, then reposition while the slow keeps them anchored. It is acquired from a corpse lying next to a wall in the southernmost quarters of the Zamor Ruins on the Mountaintops of the Giants.
name: Zamor Ice Storm
effect: Thrust staff into ground to create freezing tornado
